title: Bioceramics: bactericidal or bacteriostatic?
topic: Calcium silicate materials kill on contact when fresh, are weaker and partial once set; healing is comparable to other sealers.

claims.claim: MTA: pH 10.2 at mixing, 12.5 at 3 h (cement, pH meter)
claims.source: Torabinejad et al., J Endod 1995;21:349-53 (PMID 7499973), abstract

claims.claim: Fresh iRoot SP: all free-floating E. faecalis dead in 2 min (direct contact test, in vitro)
claims.source: Zhang et al., J Endod 2009;35:1051-5 (PMID 19567333), abstract

claims.claim: Schematic: pink pH halo, hydroxyl-ion dots and clear-zone size on the fresh plate are illustrative
claims.source: Illustration; fresh calcium silicate materials can give agar-diffusion zones: Torabinejad et al., J Endod 1995;21:403-6 (PMID 7595152)

claims.claim: Set ProRoot MTA aged in water, 1 h contact with E. faecalis: 97% killed at day 1, 82% at day 7 (in vitro)
claims.source: Farrugia et al., Sci Rep 2017;7:41359 (PMID 28128328), full text

claims.claim: Set plate shows no clear zone (set ProRoot MTA gave no inhibition zone)
claims.source: Farrugia et al., Sci Rep 2017;7:41359 (PMID 28128328), full text

claims.claim: In dentin tubules: slow, partial kill; more dead at day 30 than day 1 (in vitro; cell counts schematic)
claims.source: Wang et al., J Endod 2014;40:505-8 (PMID 24666900); Du et al., J Endod 2015;41:1294-8 (PMID 26092772), abstracts

claims.claim: Bactericidal = count falls; bacteriostatic = count held (schematic curves and colonies)
claims.source: Pankey & Sabath, Clin Infect Dis 2004;38:864-70 (PMID 14999632), concept only

claims.claim: FRESH sits on the bactericidal half; SET ? stops between the halves (set = weaker; 'bacteriostatic' not measured)
Healing: comparable to other sealers (clinical meta-analysis)
claims.source: Sabeti et al., J Endod 2024;50:735-46.e1 (PMID 38548045); Donnermeyer et al., J Dent 2026;176:107002 (PMID 42668107), abstracts

claims.claim: Evidence on antibacterial activity is mostly in vitro
claims.source: Simundic Munitic et al., PLoS One 2019;14:e0223575 (PMID 31622387), abstract

caption:
Bioceramics: bactericidal or bacteriostatic? It depends on when, and on which test.
• Freshly mixed iRoot SP killed all free-floating E. faecalis in 2 min of direct contact (AH Plus needed 5).
• Set ProRoot MTA, 1 h contact: 97% killed at day 1, 82% at day 7 (under 2 log).
• In dentin tubules sealers kill slowly and only partially over weeks.
• Clinical healing: comparable to other sealers.
Lab data are in vitro. Schematic animation: halo, zones, counts and curves are illustrative.
Refs: Zhang 2009, Wang 2014, Sabeti 2024 (J Endod); Farrugia 2017 (Sci Rep).
